content: प्रस्रवणम् .²1 Flowing or gushing forth, trickling, oozing, dripping. .²2 Flow or discharge of milk from the breast or udder; (वृक्षकान्) घटस्तनप्रस्रवणैर्व्यवर्धयत् <ls>Ku. 5. 14</ls>. .²3 A fall of water, cascade, cataract. .²4 A spring, fountain; नानामलप्रस्रवणैः <ls>Bhāg. 4. 6. 11</ls>; समाचिता प्रस्रवणैः समन्ततः <ls>Ṛs. 2. 16</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 248</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 159</ls>. .²5 A spout. .²6 A pool formed by the mountain streams. .²7 Sweat, perspiration. .²8 Voiding urine. .{@-णः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a mountain; जनस्थानमध्यगो गिरिः प्रस्रवणो नाम <ls>U. 1</ls>.
